name: footprint
comment: One row per (page, user) pair. COUNT(*) per page is the number of unique viewers.

columns.name: fp_user
columns.comment: user.user_id of the viewer. Stored as an id so renames follow automatically.

columns.name: fp_views
columns.comment: Total number of views by this user on this page

columns.name: fp_last
columns.comment: Timestamp of the most recent view

indexes.name: fp_page_last
indexes.comment: List the viewers of one page, most recent first

indexes.name: fp_user_last
indexes.comment: List the pages one user has visited, most recent first

name: footprint_log
comment: One row per counted view (same cooldown rule as footprint.fp_views). Append-only; feeds per-hour/per-day activity aggregates that a single last-seen row per (page, user) cannot answer.

columns.name: fl_id
columns.comment: Surrogate key, no meaning beyond insertion order

indexes.name: fl_timestamp
indexes.comment: Site-wide activity feed and heatmap, most recent first
